messages:
maria-finance: Evora (EVR-498) payment returned (R07). Invoice 2023-11-INV-341 for $72,430. They propose 3-month split, waive $1,450 late fee. First installment $24,143 today if we avoid suspension. Approve?
sam-accounts: We have ACH return: 'R07 - Authorization revoked by customer'. Need signed auth or card. Policy: manager signoff for >$50k.
trevor-sales: Evora is strategic SMB. Recommend 3x 0% with annual renewal clause. I can get PO tonight.
elaine-cs: Customer worried about downtime. If we accept, add 2-week no-suspend grace and daily usage alerts. CS will monitor.
billing-bot: [system] Invoice 2023-11-INV-341 status PAYMENT_RETURNED (R07). Tagging thread.
legal-team: We can draft a short payment agreement. Need company sig + billing contact. Provisional OK until signed.
sam-accounts: Provisional acceptance pending PO + signed plan. Will not blacklist yet; will flag account.
maria-finance: I'll draft the plan and attach. Trevor, confirm PO ETA? If no PO/signature by EOD tomorrow we revert to dunning cadence.
trevor-sales: PO ETA 21:00 PT today. I'll DM billing contact for signature.
maria-finance: Tagging billing-bot: payment-plan:evora:3x and reminder 48h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
